annotations.workers/message: rollback to pinned live version (unfancy recovery, source 6dcdd25)

pre_rollback_assert.assert: latest deployment id === pinned_live_deployment_id AND its version_id === pinned_live_version_id; otherwise the pin is stale -> regenerate payloads from a fresh read-only snapshot, never apply blindly.

caveats: SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN is preserved via type "inherit" only — it is never read, transported or rewritten. bindings_inherit=strict makes the upload fail (error 10057) instead of silently dropping it.
Rollback via pinned version deployment does NOT touch bindings or secret values of other versions.
